DIAGNOSIS READY: Urinary Tract Stone (Nephrolithiasis)

While I have received a request to diagnose tuberculosis, your symptoms of visible hematuria combined with right flank pain and a history of recurrent UTIs are clinically more consistent with a ureteral stone or a renal abscess.
